metadata.purpose: Framework-only P2 economic-benefit MVP scenarios using Stage 2 public evidence and explicit placeholders.
metadata.boundary: Sensor unit cost, deployment density, local prices, product prices, and field diagnostic performance remain HP/wet-lab variables.

yield_loss_rule.source: UC IPM tomato root-knot nematode spring J2/kg soil table

scenarios.hp_status: replace yield, price, intervention cost, and sensor cost with HP/local inputs before final ROI claims
scenarios.notes: Baseline yield 30 ton/acre and price $54/ton are UC IPM example values, not current market calibration.

yield_loss_rule.source: EPPO Globodera pallida datasheet citing approximately 2 t/ha loss per 20 eggs/g soil

scenarios.evidence_status: regulatory datasheet parameter transformed to normalized yield-loss fraction
scenarios.hp_status: replace normalized baseline and price with selected region potato yield and farmgate price
scenarios.notes: Normalized scenario assumes 45 t/ha only for scaling 2/45 = 4.44% loss at 20 eggs/g; do not cite as calibrated local potato economics.

scenarios.evidence_status: threshold band only; density-yield curve still requires full-text extraction
scenarios.hp_status: needs local soybean yield, price, resistant-seed premium, and SCN full-text yield function
scenarios.notes: Framework keeps SCN as a decision-rule skeleton until a model-ready density-yield function is extracted.
